verdict.rationale: Nix documents transparent binary caching that skips source builds by fetching pre-built binaries, and notes that dependencies are only built or downloaded if they are not already in the local store. A community report describes builds being done once and shared across devs and CI. Easy transfer of environments between computers hints at offline reuse, but there is no documented CI cache-restore recipe and no explicit offline install mode. Missing for 10: a documented CI cache save/restore setup, explicit offline-capable install documentation, and independent hands-on CI timing evidence.
